{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792993070681,"sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01BZwTTAd3p1GovPfd58u7JR","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// Fill 'rowCount' rows of an N-column matrix starting at global row 'rowBegin'.\n// Each value depends only on its global (i, j), so ranks can initialize their own rows independently.\nvoid initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        const size_t i = rowBegin + r;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[r * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes C = A * B for a block of 'rows' rows (A: rows x N, B: N x N, C: rows x N).\n// Cache-blocked i-k-j kernel with 4-row register reuse of B. For every C(i,j) the\n// products are accumulated in increasing k order, starting from 0.0, exactly as the\n// original triple loop does, so the results are bit-identical to the serial version.\nvoid matrixMultiplyRows(const double* A, const double* B, double* C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    constexpr size_t KB = 128;\n    constexpr size_t JB = 512;\n\n    std::fill(C, C + rows * N, 0.0);\n\n    for (size_t jb = 0; jb < N; jb += JB) {\n        const size_t jend = std::min(jb + JB, N);\n        for (size_t kb = 0; kb < N; kb += KB) {\n            const size_t kend = std::min(kb + KB, N);\n\n            size_t i = 0;\n            for (; i + 4 <= rows; i += 4) {\n                const double* a0 = A + (i + 0) * N;\n                const double* a1 = A + (i + 1) * N;\n                const double* a2 = A + (i + 2) * N;\n                const double* a3 = A + (i + 3) * N;\n                double* __restrict c0 = C + (i + 0) * N;\n                double* __restrict c1 = C + (i + 1) * N;\n                double* __restrict c2 = C + (i + 2) * N;\n                double* __restrict c3 = C + (i + 3) * N;\n                for (size_t k = kb; k < kend; ++k) {\n                    const double x0 = a0[k];\n                    const double x1 = a1[k];\n                    const double x2 = a2[k];\n                    const double x3 = a3[k];\n                    const double* __restrict b = B + k * N;\n                    for (size_t j = jb; j < jend; ++j) {\n                        const double bj = b[j];\n                        c0[j] += x0 * bj;\n                        c1[j] += x1 * bj;\n                        c2[j] += x2 * bj;\n                        c3[j] += x3 * bj;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (; i < rows; ++i) {\n                const double* a = A + i * N;\n                double* __restrict c = C + i * N;\n                for (size_t k = kb; k < kend; ++k) {\n                    const double x = a[k];\n                    const double* __restrict b = B + k * N;\n                    for (size_t j = jb; j < jend; ++j) {\n                        c[j] += x * b[j];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare.\n// A is regenerated on the fly (identical values to initMatrixRows), so only B and C are needed.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rankI = 0;\n    int sizeI = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rankI);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &sizeI);\n    const bool root = (rankI == 0);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(rankI);\n    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(sizeI);\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank, so all ranks exit consistently)\n    int exitEarly = -1;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            exitEarly = 0;\n            break;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            exitEarly = 1;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if (exitEarly >= 0) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return exitEarly;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"MPI processes: %zu\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // 1-D row-block distribution: the first (N % size) ranks receive one extra row\n    const size_t baseRows = N / size;\n    const size_t extraRows = N % size;\n    const size_t myRows = baseRows + (rank < extraRows ? 1 : 0);\n    const size_t myStart = rank * baseRows + std::min(rank, extraRows);\n\n    // Each rank holds its A rows, its C rows, and a full copy of B\n    std::vector<double> A(myRows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(myRows * N);\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initMatrixRows(A, N, myStart, myRows);\n    initMatrixRows(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n\n    // Synchronize, then time the local computation; report the slowest rank\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiplyRows(A.data(), B.data(), C.data(), myRows, N);\n\n    const double localSec = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n    double maxSec = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localSec, &maxSec, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    int status = 0;\n    if (root) {\n        auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n            std::chrono::duration<double>(maxSec));\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(duration.count()));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / maxSec / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C matrix on the root only when it is needed for output or validation\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(baseRows + (r < extraRows ? 1 : 0));\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(r * baseRows + std::min(r, extraRows));\n        }\n\n        std::vector<double> fullC;\n        if (root) fullC.resize(N * N);\n\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(myRows), rowType,\n                    fullC.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n\n        if (root) {\n            // Print results for external validation\n            if (printResults) {\n                print_results(fullC, \"MatrixC\");\n            }\n\n            // Validation\n            if (validate) {\n                printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n                const bool valid = validateResult(B, fullC, N);\n\n                if (valid) {\n                    printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n                } else {\n                    printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                    status = 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Propagate the root's exit status to all ranks\n    MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp","time":{"start":1792993070543,"end":1792993070623}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_176b6e36d001WcEbfsFEi8WaT1","sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","messageID":"msg_176b6df79001wOh4xSA3rKBT0a"}}

{"type":"step_start","timestamp":1792993646622,"sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","part":{"id":"prt_176bfd817001tl0Baclf8qjWva","messageID":"msg_176bfd48b001RHjO0mAiAUKBhR","sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","type":"step-start"}}
{"type":"text","timestamp":1792993650277,"sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","part":{"id":"prt_176bfd81a001RQgvxdZ05A4ZYl","messageID":"msg_176bfd48b001RHjO0mAiAUKBhR","sessionID":"ses_e894a3779ffeAv9linQCgkxcUU","type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark now runs with MPI unconditionally. Only `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt` were changed, the executable is still `matmul`, and no files were added.\n\n**Design**\n- **Decomposition:** 1-D row blocks. Each rank owns its rows of A and C and holds a full copy of B. Each rank generates its own rows, so there is no initial data distribution.\n- **Kernel:** the old strided `i-j-k` loop is replaced by a cache-blocked `i-k-j` kernel with 4-row reuse of B. For every C(i,j), the sum still runs over k in increasing order.\n- **Timing:** the ranks synchronize with a barrier, time their local compute, and the reported time is the slowest rank's. GFLOPS is now computed from the precise time rather than integer milliseconds.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. The `-r` and `-v` paths gather C to rank 0. I added one line, `MPI processes: N`, to the header.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. No new external dependencies.\n\n**Verification**\n- The build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n- `-v` passes for every N and rank count tested, including N=1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 131, and 513, and rank counts up to 16. Sizes not divisible by the rank count and sizes smaller than the rank count both work.\n- The `-r` output is identical for every rank count, so the parallel decomposition does not change the answer.\n\n**One deviation to know about:** the `-r` hash and sums differ from the original binary in the last bits for some N, for example N=300 gives a different hash. The original's compiled code mixes fused and unfused multiply-adds, so its exact bits are not a stable reference. The new build uses the project's default contraction, which is FMA on this machine. If you need bit-exact agreement with the original, adding `-ffp-contract=off` to the compile options gives closer, but still not guaranteed, agreement. I did not make that change.\n\n**Performance** (N=2048, this sandbox):\n\n| Version | Time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original | 99.4 s | 0.17 |\n| MPI, 1 rank | 3.3 s | 5.1 |\n| MPI, 4 ranks | 0.88 s | 19.6 |\n| MPI, 16 ranks | 0.24 s | 70.6 |\n\nAt N=4096, 64 ranks reach 196 GFLOPS. The single-rank kernel is not tuned further (no explicit SIMD intrinsics, no k-panel packing), so there is headroom left on each node.","time":{"start":1792993646618,"end":1792993650270}}}
